summary.name: Vivify GPT Image 2.5
summary.one_liner: A browser-based image generator and editor built on GPT Image 2.5, offering Flare and Sunburst modes for product visuals and reference-image edits.
use_cases: change the background of a product photo
edit reference images with text prompts
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a web tool for creating and editing images with GPT Image 2.5. Users can choose between two modes, Flare and Sunburst. The page shows an example in Flare mode where a product photo's background is changed from ivory to pastel peach while the cup is preserved. It also says the page compares features and credits with GPT Image 2 and shows real examples. The page does not give detailed specifications for either mode beyond these points.
notable: Flare and Sunburst modes selectable for generation
Example of background change while preserving the subject
Uses a credits system, compared against GPT Image 2
caveats: Paid tool; the listing is tagged #paid and the page references credits
Detailed pricing and credit amounts are not stated in the page text
